title: HP Recalls Batteries for Notebook Computers and Mobile Workstations Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards Units: About 50,000 (in addition, 2,600 were sold in Canada).

title: SureFit Recalls Riding Lawn Mower Blade Spindle Shafts Due to Impact Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The blade spindle shaft can break during lawn mowing and the broken blade pieces can become projectiles. This poses a risk of an impact injury to bystanders or damage to property. Units: About 900 (In addition, about 75 were sold in Canada).

title: Comfort Research Recalls Bean Bag Chair Covers Due to Risks of Entrapment, Suffocation to Children
summary: The zippers on the bean bag chair covers can be opened by children who can then crawl inside, become entrapped, suffocate or choke on the bean bag chair's foam beads. Units: About 1,200.

title: Panasonic Recalls Flat Screen Televisions and Swivel Stands Due to Tip-Over Hazard
summary: The mounting screws that connect the swivel stand to the television can come loose and cause the television to tip over and fall off the stand unexpectedly, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in injuries or death to children. Units: About 755 in the U.S. (In addition, 130

title: Bassinets Recalled Due to Violation of Bassinet & Cradle Standard; Made By Multipro (Recall Alert)
summary: The bassinets fail to meet the mandatory federal safety standard for bassinets and cradles, posing fall and entrapment hazards to babies. Units: About 1,000.

title: Bed Bath & Beyond Recalls Hudson Comforters by UGG Due to Risk of Mold Exposure
summary: Mold can be present, posing a risk of respiratory or other infections in individuals with compromised immune systems, damaged lungs or an allergy to mold. Units: About 175,000 in the U.S. (In addition, about 20 in Canada).

title: Hillsdale Furniture Recalls Bar Stools Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The stool seat can loosen or break off at the base, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 500.

title: Fujifilm Recalls Power Adapter Wall Plugs Sold with Digital Cameras Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The power adapter wall plug can crack, break or detach and remain in the wall and expose live electrical contacts, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 270,000 (In addition, about 24,000 were sold in Canada.).

title: Coldwater Creek Recalls Snow Globes Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Light refraction through the globes can singe or melt items in contact with or in the immediate proximity, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 43.

title: Skip Hop Recalls Convertible High Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The front legs on the highchair can detach from the seat, posing fall and injury hazards to children. Units: About 7,900 in U.S. (In addition, 2,000 in Canada).

title: John Deere Recalls Compact Utility Tractors Due To Crash and Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The brakes can fail, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 600 (In addition, 5 were sold in Canada).

title: LEDVANCE Recalls Recessed Canister Light Kits Due to Shock and Electrocution Hazards
summary: The recalled recessed canister light kits can short circuit, posing a shock and electrocution hazard when consumers try to troubleshoot flickering lights. Units: About 45,000 in the U.S. (In addition, about 11,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Vornado Air Recalls Cribside Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: A broken motor mount can allow the electric heating element to come in contact with the interior plastic materials and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 5,000 in the U.S. (In addition, about 100 were sold in Canada.).

title: Walgreens Pain and Itch Relief Cream Recalled by Natureplex Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pain and itch relief cream contains lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children. Units: About 74,000.

title: Elkay Recalls Water Coolers and Bottle Filling Stations Due to Shock Hazard
summary: Internal screws that secure the grounding wire can break and allow the grounding wire to become loose, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 31,600.

title: Rockler Recalls Murphy Bed Kits Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The hardware kits used to secure the wooden wall enclosures to the wall studs do not provide sufficient bracing support, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 2,300.

title: VTech Recalls Infant Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The ears on the elephant rattles can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 280,000.

title: VTech Recalls Lights & Lullabies Travel Mobiles Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The clamp attaching the mobile to the crib rail can break causing the mobile to fall, posing an injury hazard to an infant in the crib. Units: About 37,000 in the U.S. (In addition, 4,800 were sold in Canada.).

title: Fashion Accessory Bazaar Recalls Fidget Spinner Keychains Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The center post on the fidget spinner can become loose or fall out, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 20,000.
